title: 秋華賞の後に・1歩、再び

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Mejiro Dober! You were awesome—just incredible! That was an amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …I've fulfilled my promise and watched over your classic year, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The next time we meet, you and I will be…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (It's over. The Triple Tiara is over.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I don't regret anything. After all, I ran without holding anything back.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (So many people supported me throughout this.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can't cry… I have to stay strong for their sake!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober leaves the crowd behind, and I head out to meet her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I may not have won the Triple Tiara, but I'm satisfied with how things turned out.
choice_data_list: You ran with everything you had.
You ran with everything you had.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I did. That's why I can be proud of what I did… and why I can move forward too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Will you continue taking on new challenges with me tomorrow, just as you always have?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Will you continue taking on new challenges with me tomorrow, just as you always have?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: All right… Then I guess we'll be taking our first step together again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Mejiro Dober and I forge ahead toward a new challenge and a new stage together!
